what: The input of v1.37's second-batch dictation re-measure (round 1, corpus-1): instrument 1b on the five dictation-pool sentences that taught 一日 as ついたち where exEN is a duration, run on the CORRECTED corpus (いちにち). The complaint '一日 ついたち -> いちにち' makes both readings candidates, and EXTRA adds いちじつ and every spelling in katakana. Same-run controls with a known answer: n5-b018 (一日 proven ついたち by v1.29 1b against the corpus いちにち), n3-b020 (十分 proven じゅうぶん), n2-b1180 (十センチ proven じゅっせんち), n4-b186 (一晩 proven ひとばん), n2-b034 (SILENT on 一晩中); n5-b303 (the date 四月一日) and n3-g327 (一日中, corrected to いちにちじゅう) for information; and the decoys. The same spec on the shipped tokens (before the correction) gave RELEASE on ついたち for n2-g300, n2-b029, n2-b1064 and n4-b151: corpus-proposals-ichinichi.json.
